requirements.quote: The power supply module must incorporate a battery charger capability that will charge the battery when the input power is from the 5V DC source.
requirements.text: The power supply module must charge the battery using a 5V DC input.

requirements.quote: The power supply module must be supplied with documentation.
requirements.text: Documentation must be provided with the power supply module.

requirements.quote: The power supply module shall contain datasheets for all components including the battery, PCB binary files, and circuit diagrams.
requirements.text: Datasheets for all components must be included with the power supply module.

requirements.quote: Provide a documentation report for the power supply module together with datasheets for the BOM, Schematic Diagram for the Power Supply Module and Gerber Files for the PCB.
requirements.text: Submit a documentation report with datasheets, schematic diagram, and Gerber files for the power supply module.

requirements.quote: Perform the following system acceptance tests to the expected results as outlined in table 1.
requirements.text: Conduct system acceptance tests as per table 1's expected results.

requirements.quote: Test report outlining the test cases (as per table 1) outcome results.
requirements.text: Provide a test report detailing test cases and their outcomes.

requirements.quote: Test report addressing the mentioned expected results.
requirements.text: Submit a test report addressing the expected results.
